observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon-branded box with a large DSLR camera body and lens mounted; the box is damaged/creased and taped.
Photo 1 shows the camera packaging opened/stacked with manuals and Nikon-branded inserts; model text on the box is not clearly readable.
Photo 2 shows the camera and accessories wrapped in bubble wrap inside the carton; no clear view of the camera model name/number or condition indicators.

claims.evidence: The photos show Nikon packaging and a Nikon DSLR, but the D750 model number is not readable in the provided images.
Only packaging and bubble wrap are clearly visible; the camera exterior/condition (scratches, sensor dust, shutter count) is not shown.
No powered-on screen, menu, autofocus test, shutter actuation, or image taken is shown.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (camera may not be D750; could be another Nikon DSLR).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body showing the model name/number (e.g., on the front/top) and the rear screen with the model info, plus a close-up of the lens mount area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon DSLR body with unknown model/condition (worst case vs the claimed D750).

risks.risk: Not actually working (faulty shutter, dead sensor, battery/charger issues, broken buttons).
risks.proof: Video/clip of powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing the image on the rear screen (plus a short autofocus test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until proven.

risks.risk: Damage from shipping/storage (box is visibly creased; internal parts may be affected).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the camera exterior and lens mount for cracks/dents, and a test shot showing no abnormal artifacts.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (seller says 'Body' but photos don’t confirm what’s included: battery, charger, cables, strap).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included item with counts (battery, charger, cables, strap, caps).
risks.if_unproven: Price as body only with no guaranteed accessories.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the camera showing the exact model (D750 or otherwise) on the body.
Send a short video: power on → menu screen → take a photo → playback on the rear screen.
Send photos of the lens mount and exterior for any cracks/dents/scratches.
List and show all included accessories (battery, charger, caps/strap) with counts.
response.reason: The photos confirm Nikon packaging and a Nikon DSLR, but the exact D750 model and working condition are not verifiable from the images. Without a powered-on/test proof and readable model identification, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
